description: Header file defining bit manipulation utility functions for jemalloc, including bit scanning, power-of-two calculations, and size-related bit operations.

methods.name: ffs_llu
methods.description: Returns the index of the first set bit in an unsigned long long.

methods.name: ffs_lu
methods.description: Returns the index of the first set bit in an unsigned long.

methods.name: ffs_u
methods.description: Returns the index of the first set bit in an unsigned int.

methods.name: popcount_lu
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an unsigned long, if JEMALLOC_INTERNAL_POPCOUNTL is defined.

methods.name: cfs_lu
methods.description: Clears the first unset bit in a bitmap and returns its position.

methods.name: ffs_zu
methods.description: Returns the index of the first set bit in a size_t, depending on pointer size.

methods.name: ffs_u64
methods.description: Returns the index of the first set bit in a uint64_t.

methods.name: ffs_u32
methods.description: Returns the index of the first set bit in a uint32_t.

methods.name: pow2_ceil_u64
methods.description: Calculates the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x for 64-bit integers.

methods.name: pow2_ceil_u32
methods.description: Calculates the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x for 32-bit integers.

methods.name: pow2_ceil_zu
methods.description: Calculates the smallest power of two greater than or equal to x for size_t, depending on pointer size.

methods.name: lg_floor
methods.description: Computes the floor of the binary logarithm of x.

methods.name: lg_ceil
methods.description: Computes the ceiling of the binary logarithm of x.
